mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.paper_id,p.paper_name,e.class_id,c.class_period,p.course_id,p.stage_name,e.start_time,e.end_time, e.duration_minutes,e.answer_visible,CAST(e.invigilator_user_id AS UNSIGNED) invigilator_user_id, COALESCE(u.real_name,u.nickname,u.username) invigilator_name,p.total_score, r.id record_id,r.status record_status,r.grading_status,r.start_time record_start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time,r.score FROM exam e JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id=e.paper_id JOIN sys_class c ON c.id=e.class_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=CAST(e.invigilator_user_id AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN student_exam_record r ON r.exam_id=e.id AND r.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE e.class_id=#{classId} ORDER BY e.start_time DESC,e.id DESC
SELECT * FROM student_exam_record WHERE exam_id=#{examId} AND student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE student_exam_record SET status='TIMEOUT',updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE student_exam_record SET submit_time=#{submitTime},status='SUBMITTED',grading_status=#{gradingStatus},score=#{score},updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT pq.id,pq.paper_id,pq.question_id,q.question_content,q.question_type,q.difficulty,q.answer_content correct_answer, q.analysis_content,pq.question_score FROM exam_paper_question pq JOIN exam_question q ON q.id=pq.question_id WHERE pq.paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY pq.id

SELECT r.id record_id,e.id exam_id,s.id student_id,s.student_name,s.student_phone, COALESCE(r.status,'NOT_STARTED') record_status,r.grading_status,r.score,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time FROM exam e JOIN student s ON s.class_id=e.class_id LEFT JOIN student_exam_record r ON r.exam_id=e.id AND r.student_id=s.id WHERE e.id=#{examId} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT r.id record_id,r.exam_id,e.paper_id,p.paper_name,c.class_period,p.stage_name,r.student_id,s.student_name,s.student_phone, p.total_score,r.score,r.status record_status,r.grading_status,e.answer_visible,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time FROM student_exam_record r JOIN exam e ON e.id=r.exam_id JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id=e.paper_id JOIN sys_class c ON c.id=e.class_id JOIN student s ON s.id=r.student_id WHERE r.id=#{recordId}

SELECT pq.id,a.id answer_id,pq.question_id,q.question_content,q.question_type,pq.question_score,a.answer_content, q.answer_content correct_answer,q.analysis_content,a.correct,a.score FROM student_exam_record r JOIN exam e ON e.id=r.exam_id JOIN exam_paper_question pq ON pq.paper_id=e.paper_id JOIN exam_question q ON q.id=pq.question_id LEFT JOIN student_exam_answer a ON a.record_id=r.id AND a.question_id=pq.question_id WHERE r.id=#{recordId} ORDER BY pq.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_exam_answer WHERE record_id=#{recordId} AND score IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score),0) FROM student_exam_answer WHERE record_id=#{recordId}
mapper.update: UPDATE student_exam_record SET status='TIMEOUT',updated_at=NOW() WHERE exam_id=#{examId} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' AND deadline_time<=#{now}
